verdict.rationale: Retell's AI QA feature automatically scores sampled calls on hallucination, knowledge base accuracy, latency, sentiment, and tool usage, and the Analytics dashboard tracks success rate and other metrics, directly matching the story's core ask of automated call scoring and quality flagging. However, evidence shows AI QA only evaluates a 'sampled set' of calls (not all calls) against user-configured rules, and there's no documented automatic 'resolution analysis' narrative beyond metrics/dashboards, nor independent hands-on validation of AI QA accuracy. missing for 10: evidence of full (non-sampled) coverage, independent/third-party validation of AI QA scoring accuracy, and detail on automated resolution/failure-cause analysis beyond configured metrics.
